title: Wiseman fails to replicate Sheldrake's psychic dog experiments

tellings.quote: So Richard Wisman tried to conduct the exact same experiments with the dog and he's published these and he gets no results.

plain: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake ran experiments on a dog said to sense when its owner was coming home, and a psychologist named Richard Wiseman tried to run "the exact same experiments" in England, published them, and got no results. That is how the skeptic Michael Shermer tells it, summarising the published work without naming it, during a debate with Michels. He also mentions the statistician Jessica Utts. For Shermer, the failed repeat is a reason to doubt the psychic dog claim.
